answer: Each identity registers its basalt funding wallet, locks 50 and pays 15. Every payout carries a pigment tag from that root, so shared roots share tags. Each epoch a pulse audit groups payouts by tag in the basalt ledger, caps payout per root at 100, and burns excess. The k-th identity under one root costs 65 but adds zero payout once the cap is hit, so cost rises linearly while gain stays flat. 1,000 fakes cost 65,000 for at most 100 payout. Renting roots fails: each new root must lock 200, so 1,000 rented roots add 200,000, totalling 265,000. One honest agent pays 65 once.
